unit: local-only-control (stress: rare family never logged at home)
what: Stress experiment. Each site trains the same network alone, with the failure family it rarely sees withheld from its training labels (Site A: y_mobility = 0, Site B: y_congestion = 0, as if never logged). Telemetry is untouched. Scoring always uses the true labels.

target.metric: AUROC on the frozen test days for the withheld family at home (Site A: y_mobility, Site B: y_congestion), local-only model
target.direction: expected at or below 0.60 (the model has never been told this family exists); the federated model must beat it

threshold_rule: a withheld family has no labels at home, so its F1 threshold is calibrated on the other site's validation days
